title: Sam Okuayinonu set to have foot surgery, 49ers hope for return late in season

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Sam Okuayinonu set to have foot surgery, 49ers hope for return late in season
sources.description: San Francisco coach Kyle Shanahan shared the initial outlook for 49ers defensive end Sam Okuayinonu, who is set to undergo surgery for a foot injury.
